scope: Connector, inherited public members, both collection add_connector owners, complete connector enum symbols/alias/helpers; no underscore-name exclusions.

languageSecurityMapping.names: Neutral snake_case model names retained; async operation options camelCase; no blanket aliases.
languageSecurityMapping.construction: Returned live owned Connector remains a separate contract from a detached XML Shape/Connector view. Raw XML constructors do not establish Presentation graph parity.
languageSecurityMapping.protocol: equals(other) is owner/underlying-element equality; JS === remains reference identity. Shapes use length, Symbol.iterator, checked zero-based at(index), negative positions only where documented; CLI ordinals one-based.
languageSecurityMapping.values: Length objects expose exact safe integer .emu; strict finite values and enum validation; null only for explicit absence. Coordinates use immediate-parent space; cross-group projection must be explicit and validated.
languageSecurityMapping.io: Byte admission/publication always async through caller capabilities. In-memory views synchronous. No implicit host paths, network, native execution, timestamps, or identity.
languageSecurityMapping.elementPart: Bounded XML/package views only; no raw XPath or unrestricted library/host interfaces. Missing model members remain gaps.
languageSecurityMapping.errors: Neutral OfficeError codes; invalid-value for malformed arguments, unsupported-edit for opaque geometry; owner/site validation before mutation; typed model error parity remains separately accountable.

drift: Historical audit and generated batch paths are baseline design, not present implementation evidence.
Connection functions mutate both attachment metadata and endpoint coordinates; generic pure-call text in the historical register is incorrect for these methods.
Automatic GroupShapes ancestor extent recalculation is a model obligation, distinct from package insertion.
MIXED is a read sentinel and not a creatable connector preset.
Numeric connector enum metadata uses metadata(value).name/value/xml_value rather than Python enum instances; frozen metadata rejects reassignment.
Connector construction currently accepts a bounded XmlPart snapshot and optional shapeId. It does not pretend to return a Presentation-owned object.
readShape retains absent geometry as null; connector endpoint edits require explicit valid geometry instead of inventing zero coordinates.
Actual begin_connect/end_connect calls mutate attachment metadata and endpoint geometry; they are not pure calls despite generic historical effect text.
